title: 第21章 激烈无比的擂台赛第22章 赵李两家的后手
slug: 和女帝双修后我出剑即无敌
lines: “玉凤姐你没事吧？”
身负重伤，再从高台坠下，搞不好就会香消玉殒。
好在郑元身法高明，只不过看到眼前的郑玉凤气若游丝气的肺都要炸了。
贱人王艳太狠了，是自己连累了玉凤姐。
“我没事，你一定要把灵石矿争过来。”
郑玉凤突然双手抓着郑元的胳膊用尽力气说道，紧接着双眼一闭晕了过去。
“玉凤，玉凤姐……”
郑家族长脸色变得苍白无力，郑家之人更是赶紧上前帮忙。
嗖！
郑元把郑玉凤放下身形一晃飞上了擂台：“贱人，找死！”
刚才出手这么狠，成心就是要置郑玉凤于死地。
简直就是一个蛇蝎美人，郑元也不由怒了。
就在一拳要打出时一道身形从下面也飞了上来。
“郑元，你的对手是我。”
正是李家的大公子李承风，手里拿着一柄长刀，身上的气势磅礴而出。
至于王艳冷冷一笑：“郑元，本姑娘就是要你亲眼看到你郑家之人一个个死去。”
王艳也知道自己不是郑元对手，刚才也不知道怎么啦，一眼看到台下郑元对他妹妹的关心就怒火上来了。
不过打伤郑玉凤也无所谓了，毕竟两家早就撕破脸皮了，王艳嗖的一下子跳下了擂台。
“李公子……”
台下瞬间传来阵阵欢呼声，那就是李承风晋级到开脉四层境界了。
这在浩城可以说是凤毛麟角了，这资质即使是宗门也能进入。
而郑元才开脉一层境界，两人修为上差得太远了。
所以必败无疑，这次三大家族争夺灵石矿基本没有什么悬念了。
郑元看了一眼王艳把目光收了回来，以后再收拾那个贱人。
“如你所愿！”
郑元突然身形一震，一股气势节节攀升了起来，开脉二层，开脉三层，修为稳稳停在了开脉三层。
呼！
本来已经以为没有悬念的众人嘴里发出阵阵惊呼声。
要知道当初郑元以开脉一层修为就打败过红云宗开脉三层的弟子龙啸天。
一个能越级挑战的天才，今天是否还会再出现奇迹呢。
“不可能，他怎么可能晋级速度这么快，一定是假的……”
台下的王艳嘴里大喊着，一脸不可思议之色。
更是气的花枝乱颤，短短半个月不到，郑元就晋升了两个大境界。
这资质也太恐怖了，王艳的指甲都深深陷进肉里了。
擂台下的城主女儿楚琳却是俏脸露出一丝喜色。
没想到郑公子修为晋级速度这么快。
可以称之为天之骄子了，这样也许父亲大人会答应自己嫁给他的。
那天回到府里，楚琳才发现什么叫相思之苦。
只不过也知道郑元要为三天后大比做准备，所以并没有贸然去郑家。
当然作为一个女儿家，要是碰到郑元的父母也太尴尬了，会不会让未来公婆认为自己是个轻浮的女子。
“这小子，还真是有点意思。”
擂台下一个老者也在看着郑元，嘴里喃喃自语着。
郑元自然不知道暗中有人在观察自己，向着台下热情无比的观众挥了挥手。
动作潇洒飘逸，更是引起了台下少女们的连连尖叫声。
content_en:
"Sister Yufeng, are you okay?"
If you are seriously injured and fall from a high platform, you may die.
Fortunately, Zheng Yuan was very skilled in physical skills, but seeing Zheng Yufeng in front of him was so angry that his lungs were about to explode.
Bitch Wang Yan is too cruel, and she is the one who caused Sister Yufeng to suffer.
"I'm fine. You must fight for the spirit stone mine."
Zheng Yufeng suddenly grabbed Zheng Yuan's arm with both hands and said with all her strength, then she closed her eyes and fainted.
"Yufeng, Sister Yufeng..."
The head of the Zheng family turned pale and weak, and the Zheng family members rushed forward to help.
Whoosh!
Zheng Yuan put Zheng Yufeng down and flew onto the ring: "Bitch, you are looking for death!"
The attack was so ruthless just now, with the intention of killing Zheng Yufeng.
She was simply a femme fatale, and Zheng Yuan couldn't help but get angry.
Just when he was about to punch out, a figure flew up from below.
"Zheng Yuan, your opponent is me."
It was Li Chengfeng, the eldest son of the Li family, holding a long sword in his hand and exuding a majestic aura.
As for Wang Yan, she smiled coldly: "Zheng Yuan, I just want you to see your Zheng family members die one by one with your own eyes."
Wang Yan also knew that she was no match for Zheng Yuan, and she didn't know what happened just now. She became angry when she saw Zheng Yuan's concern for his sister in the audience.
But it didn't matter if he injured Zheng Yufeng. After all, the two families had already been at odds with each other. Wang Yan jumped off the ring in a whoosh.
"Master Li..."
There were bursts of cheers from the audience, it was that Li Chengfeng had advanced to the fourth level of opening the pulse.
This can be said to be rare in Haocheng, and even a sect with this qualification can enter.
Zheng Yuan was only at the first level of Kai Mai, so the difference in cultivation between the two was too far.
Therefore, there is no doubt that they will lose. This time, there is basically no suspense among the three major families competing for the Lingshi Mine.
Zheng Yuan glanced at Wang Yan and looked away, and would deal with that bitch later.
"As you wish!"
Zheng Yuan suddenly trembled, and his momentum rose steadily. He opened the meridians at the second level, opened the meridians at the third level, and his cultivation steadily stopped at the third level.
call!
Everyone who originally thought there was no suspense burst into exclamations.
You must know that Zheng Yuan defeated Long Xiaotian, a disciple of Hongyun Sect who was on the third level of opening meridians with his first-level cultivation level.
A genius who can leapfrog challenges, will there be another miracle today?
"Impossible, how could he be promoted so fast? It must be fake..."
Wang Yan in the audience shouted, with a look of disbelief on her face.
He was even more furious. In less than half a month, Zheng Yuan had been promoted to two great realms.
This qualification was so terrifying that Wang Yan's nails dug deeply into her flesh.
Under the ring, the city lord's daughter Chu Lin showed a hint of joy on her pretty face.
I didn’t expect Mr. Zheng’s cultivation level to advance so quickly.
You can call him the proud son of heaven, so maybe your father will agree to marry him.
When she returned to the house that day, Chu Lin discovered what the pain of lovesickness was.
But he also knew that Zheng Yuan had to prepare for the competition in three days, so he didn't rush to Zheng's house.
Of course, as a daughter's family, it would be too embarrassing to meet Zheng Yuan's parents. Will her future parents-in-law think that she is a frivolous woman?
"This kid is really interesting."
An old man under the ring was also looking at Zheng Yuan, muttering to himself.
Zheng Yuan naturally didn't know that someone was secretly observing him, so he waved to the enthusiastic audience.
The movements were free and elegant, which aroused repeated screams from the girls in the audience.
